headline: Territorial Upheaval Shifts Toward Weathered Expanse and Linn of Mercy
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch three hours ago, the frontline's shifting center has gravitated decisively toward Linn of Mercy and Weathered Expanse, which together registered thirteen base transfers over the last two hours. In Weathered Expanse, relentless pressure around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch produced six rapid turnovers right up to the hour, accompanied by nearly eighteen hundred casualties. Linn of Mercy simultaneously boiled over with seven base shifts centered on Outwich Ranch and Rotdust as combined losses topped eleven hundred. In Mooring County, where fierce trading previously raged, territorial exchange halted entirely following an early evening skirmish, though relentless attrition continues unabated with over three thousand casualties logged in two hours. Callum's Cape also saw base transitions taper to a pair of flips at Naofa and Scouts Jest, despite a staggering toll of thirty-five hundred casualties in the same span. Elsewhere, secondary flare-ups in Marban Hollow, Lykos Isle, and The Fingers have completely subsided over the past two hours, granting those embattled sectors a tense respite.
